theorems.name: Submission.critSlices_cube_cover
theorems.statement: ∀ (n M : ℕ) (R : ℝ), 0 < M → 0 ≤ R → ∃ Q : (Fin n → Fin M) → Set (Rn n), (∀ α, Convex ℝ (Q α)) ∧ (∀ α, Q α ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 (Real.sqrt n * R)) ∧ (∀ α, ∀ u ∈ Q α, ∀ v ∈ Q α, dist u v ≤ Real.sqrt n * (2 * R / M)) ∧ Metric.closedBall (0 : Rn n) R ⊆ ⋃ α, Q α
